caption: The drawing shows a group of seven people, all wearing hats and period clothing in shades of pink and white, pulling a fire engine with large wheels labeled “13” on its side. The fire engine is colored in pink and red with some brown detailing and is located to the right of the people and beneath a large leafy tree that has a brown trunk, green and teal leaves, and white circular details scattered across its branches. In the background, there are two brick buildings with white-framed windows, chimneys, and brown roofs. The left building is on fire, with swirling brown smoke emerging from the windows and roof. The doors and some window interiors are filled in with a deep teal color. The overall background color of the artwork is a rich blue. The composition is rectangular, with all elements arranged horizontally across the frame.
title: Bandbox Design
